description: The ODIV2 output of an IBUFDS_GTE2 reaches the fabric through MGTCLKOUT and drives a BUFGCE
exercises: the list of fabric clock buffers an IBUFDS_GTE2 output may drive
the ODIV2 output of the IBUFDS_GTE2 site
why: The packer's list of the fabric clock buffers an IBUFDS_GTE2 output may drive held BUFG, BUFH, BUFHCE and BUFR only, so a reference clock divided by two could not reach a BUFGCE: the flow stopped with "output ODIV2 can only drive a BUFG/BUFH/BUFHCE/BUFR, not BUFGCE". The site type of the buffer also had no ODIV2 output, so the pin had no wire to leave through.
